sections.title: Course record
sections.note: Draft only. Verify disclosure permission. Clinician must add assessments, treatment provided and recommendations before sending.

sections.title: Recorded sessions
sections.sql: select starts_at,status from sessions where referral_id=$1 order by starts_at

sections.title: Invoices and receipts
sections.sql: select name,payer,currency,amount_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,due_on from v_debtors where id in(select id from invoices where client_id=$1) order by due_on
sections.note: Amounts shown in the invoice currency. AUD and NZD remain separate. Verify payer and recipient before sharing.

name: session-summary
title: Clinical record: restricted
for_each: select id,id::text name from sessions where status='completed'

sections.title: Session
sections.sql: select client,practitioner,starts_at,status from v_diary where id=$1

sections.title: Clinician record
sections.sql: select body,author,finalised_at from notes where session_id=$1
sections.note: Draft until finalised. This is a record, not a diagnosis generated by software.

sections.title: Dated corrections
sections.sql: select a.body,a.author,a.created_at from addenda a join notes n on n.id=a.note_id where n.session_id=$1 order by a.created_at
